_readme: Option B: works with no database. Anything set here is used by the public pages. Values saved from the admin panel take priority over this file. 'pages' keys: index, how-it-is-done, about-us, fue-candidate, fue-results, contact, privacy, terms; each can set title, description, canonical, ogTitle, ogDescription, ogImage, robots ('noindex' or ''), schema (JSON as a string). 'images' maps a built-in picture path to a replacement: { "images/about.webp": { "url": "/images/my-new-photo.webp" } }. 'tracking.head' / 'tracking.body' hold Google tags.
